E = hc / λ = 1239.8 / λ(nm) eV · 焰色 = 电子: E = hc / λ = 1239.8 / λ(nm) eV · flame color = light emitted by electron transitions
金属在火焰里为什么各有各的颜色，这点颜色凭什么能当成「化验报告」？: Why does each metal give its own color in a flame, and why can that color serve as a "lab report"?
灼烧金属或它们的化合物，火焰带上特征颜色: Heat a metal or its compounds and the flame takes on a characteristic color
电子从激发态跳回低能级，放出 E = hc/λ 的光: Electrons drop from excited states to lower levels, emitting light with E = hc/λ
微量钠盐放出 589 nm 的黄，先洗净铂丝、再滤黄: Traces of sodium salts emit 589 nm yellow, so clean the platinum wire first and filter the yellow
光谱仪把颜色拆成特征谱线，用来鉴定元素: A spectrometer splits color into characteristic lines to identify elements
整体 · 一张实验台上烧六种试样、滤掉黄光、把颜色拆成谱线: Overview · on one bench, burn six samples, filter out the yellow, and split the color into lines
拖一个滑块，火苗颜色、光谱与读数一起变: Drag a slider and the flame color, spectrum and readings change together
全对！颜色来自电子跃迁，干扰来自微量钠盐，仪器决定你能不能把它们分开。: All correct! The color comes from electron transitions, the interference from traces of sodium salts, and the instrument decides whether you can tell them apart.
建议回看主线：先分清「颜色说的是哪种元素」，再看「什么会把颜色搞乱」，最后看「仪: Try reviewing the main thread: first tell "which element the color means", then "what can confuse the color", and finally "how the instrument separates it".
火苗颜色 = 试样的焰色（被钠黄盖住时转黄）: Flame color = the sample's flame color (turns yellow when masked by sodium)
蓝色钴玻璃：滤去 589 nm 的黄光: Blue cobalt glass: filters out 589 nm yellow light
能级图 · 示意放大 · 正在看：④ 光谱仪: Energy level diagram · schematic close-up · now viewing: ④ Spectrometer
700 nm 以上为近红外 · 肉眼几乎看不见: Above 700 nm is near-infrared · barely visible to the eye
灼烧工位 · 酒精灯外焰: Burning station · alcohol lamp outer flame
六种试样 · 盐酸洗瓶: Six samples · hydrochloric acid wash bottle
蓝色钴玻璃 · 滤去黄光: Blue cobalt glass · filters yellow light
700 nm 以上 · 近红外（肉眼几乎看不见）: Above 700 nm · near-infrared (barely visible to the eye)
酒精灯 + 横持的铂丝（熔嵌在玻璃棒上）；火苗颜色随试样变: Alcohol lamp + a platinum wire held sideways (fused into a glass rod); the flame color changes with the sample
六支试剂瓶（LiCl / Na₂CO₃ / K₂CO₃ / CaCl₂ / Sr: Six reagent bottles (LiCl / Na₂CO₃ / K₂CO₃ / CaCl₂ / SrCl₂ / CuCl₂) + a hydrochloric acid wash bottle
带手柄的方形蓝玻璃滤片，立在支架上；开时挡在火焰与眼睛之间: A square blue glass filter with a handle, standing on a holder; when on, it sits between the flame and your eye
台式箱体：入射狭缝宽度可调 + 读数屏（主谱线 λ 与 E）+ 400–780: Benchtop box: adjustable entrance slit width + readout (main line λ and E) + 400–780 nm spectrum strip
悬空挂板：Li / Na / K 三个原子的能级与向下跃迁箭头（箭头颜色 = 该: Floating board: energy levels of Li / Na / K atoms with downward transition arrows (arrow color = that element's flame color)
六种金属在火焰里各有各的颜色，这点颜色凭什么能当「化验报告」？: Six metals each give their own color in a flame. Why can that color serve as a "lab report"?
五个站位都在：① 酒精灯与铂丝、② 六支试样瓶（配盐酸洗瓶）、③ 蓝色钴玻璃、④: All five stations are here: ① alcohol lamp and platinum wire, ② six sample bottles (with HCl wash bottle), ③ blue cobalt glass, ④ spectrometer, ⑤ energy level board. Main reading 589.2 nm, yellow flame (sodium carbonate sample)
焰色试验：火焰特征色 → 试样所含金属元素: Flame test: characteristic flame color → metal element in the sample
酒精灯外焰 · 铂丝 · 蓝色钴玻璃 · 光谱仪: Alcohol lamp outer flame · platinum wire · blue cobalt glass · spectrometer
一个站位回答一个问题：怎么烧、六种试样、为什么滤黄、什么仪器、为什么发光。: Each station answers one question: how to burn, the six samples, why filter yellow, what instrument, why it emits light.
六支试样瓶并排，才看得出「换一种盐就换一种颜色」。: With six sample bottles side by side you can see "change the salt, change the color".
屏上的 589.2 nm 是光谱仪给出的数，不是眼睛给的——眼睛只能说「黄」。: The 589.2 nm on screen comes from the spectrometer, not the eye; the eye can only say "yellow".
去掉这一步：学生把焰色当成「烧一烧好玩」，不知道它是定性判断元素的方法。: Skip this step and students treat flame tests as "fun burning", not a qualitative method for identifying elements.
常考：焰色试验属于什么分析操作；钠的焰色为什么是黄色。: Commonly tested: what kind of analysis a flame test is; why sodium's flame is yellow.
根据火焰呈现的特征颜色，可以判断试样所含的金属元素，这种定性分析操作叫焰色试验（: From the characteristic color of the flame you can tell which metal element a sample contains; this qualitative analysis is called a flame test (textbook wording).
A2.3、A2.4、A3.1、B2.1 标准值表 1: A2.3, A2.4, A3.1, B2.1, standard values table 1
同一根铂丝连烧两种试样，第二次为什么还会带出上一种的颜色？: Burn two samples in a row on the same platinum wire. Why does the second still show the first one's color?
铂丝现在没洗——先用盐酸洗净并灼烧到火焰恢复空白，再看铜试样: The wire hasn't been cleaned yet. Wash it with hydrochloric acid and heat until the flame is blank again, then look at the copper sample
铜试样：铂丝未洗净时火焰黄（钠干扰可见度 3.53，残留钠盐把铜绿盖住），洗净后: Copper sample: with an unclean wire the flame is yellow (sodium interference visibility 3.53; leftover sodium salt masks the copper green); once cleaned it turns green (0.009). The main line is 498 nm both times: the spectrometer isn't fooled by the contamination
CuCl₂ 试样 · 铂丝未洗净 → 已洗净 · 狭缝 0.05 mm: CuCl₂ sample · wire not cleaned → cleaned · slit 0.05 mm
洗净的作用是把上一种试样的残留「洗掉 + 烧掉」，火焰回到空白。: Cleaning "washes off + burns off" the previous sample's residue so the flame returns to blank.
盐酸把残留的钠盐溶走，教材指定用盐酸而不是只用清水。: Hydrochloric acid dissolves leftover sodium salts; the textbook specifies hydrochloric acid, not just water.
这是本课的错误操作示范：不洗 → 黄色冒出来 → 要能解释是残留钠盐的 589: This is the lesson's wrong-procedure demo: don't clean → yellow appears → explain that leftover sodium salt's 589 nm line has lit up.
去掉这一步：学生以为焰色只由金属本身决定，不知道颜色会串味。: Skip this step and students think the flame color depends only on the metal, not knowing colors can carry over.
高频：焰色试验前为什么用盐酸洗铂丝、为什么要灼烧至与原火焰颜色相同。: Frequently tested: why the platinum wire is washed with hydrochloric acid before a flame test, and why it's heated until the flame matches the original.
每换一种试样，先把铂丝用盐酸洗净、在外焰上灼烧到与原来的火焰颜色相同；否则残留的: Before each new sample, wash the platinum wire with hydrochloric acid and heat it in the outer flame until the flame matches its original color; otherwise leftover sodium salts carry the yellow over (textbook wording).
钠的黄色，为什么在光谱仪里是两条紧挨着的线？: Why does sodium's yellow appear as two lines close together in the spectrometer?
把光谱仪狭缝从 0.30 收到 0.05 mm，看钠的两条线分开: Narrow the spectrometer slit from 0.30 to 0.05 mm and watch sodium's two lines separate
钠试样：狭缝 0.30 → 0.05 mm，主读数 589.2 → 589.0，: Sodium sample: slit 0.30 → 0.05 mm, main reading 589.2 → 589.0, and the lines at 589.0 and 589.6 separate (0.6 nm apart); at 0.50 mm they merge into one again and you can only read the midpoint, 589.2
颜色是眼睛给的粗数据，谱线是仪器给的细数据。: Color is coarse data from the eye; spectral lines are fine data from the instrument.
两条线的间隔 0.6 nm 由元素定，能不能分开由仪器的半高宽定。: The 0.6 nm gap between the lines is set by the element; whether they separate is set by the instrument's line width (FWHM).
分不开时读数报中点 589.2，这是仪器精度决定的；写成 589.0 就是假精度: When they can't be separated, report the midpoint 589.2; that's the instrument's precision, and writing 589.0 is false precision.
去掉这一步：学生以为波长就是一个精确的数，不知道读数还带着仪器的分辨力。: Skip this step and students think a wavelength is one exact number, not knowing readings carry the instrument's resolution.
高频：钠双线在光谱史上怎么被认出（夫琅禾费 D 线）；仪器分辨力与读数位数的关系: Frequently tested: how the sodium doublet was recognized in the history of spectroscopy (Fraunhofer D lines); how instrument resolution relates to the digits in a reading.
钠的黄光是 589.0 与 589.6 两条线（钠双线）；仪器分不开时只能读出中: Sodium's yellow light is two lines, 589.0 and 589.6 (the sodium doublet); when the instrument can't separate them you can only read the midpoint 589.2, not a single wavelength accurate to 0.1 nm.
A2.7、B2.5、B2.1 算子 2、标准值表 1–4、D4: A2.7, B2.5, B2.1 operator 2, standard values tables 1–4, D4
钾的焰色到底是紫是黄，为什么必须透过蓝色钴玻璃看？: Is potassium's flame purple or yellow, and why must you look through blue cobalt glass?
把蓝色钴玻璃挡在火焰前面，看钾的颜色变不变: Put the blue cobalt glass in front of the flame and see whether potassium's color changes
钾试样：钴玻璃关 → 火焰黄（钠干扰可见度 2.14，被碳酸钾里的微量钠盐盖住）: Potassium sample: cobalt glass off → yellow flame (sodium interference visibility 2.14, masked by traces of sodium salt in the potassium carbonate); on → purple flame (0.119), main line 404.4 nm. The main line is 404.4 nm either way; what changes is the brightness of the interfering 589.0 line
钴玻璃关 → 开 · 狭缝 0.05 mm · 766.5 nm 那条看不见: Cobalt glass off → on · slit 0.05 mm · the 766.5 nm line is invisible
钾不是「有时紫有时黄」，而是紫色一直被钠黄盖着，滤掉黄才显出来。: Potassium isn't "sometimes purple, sometimes yellow": its purple is always covered by sodium yellow and only shows once the yellow is filtered.
干扰来自碳酸钾里的微量钠盐（教材脚注），不是钾本身显黄。: The interference comes from traces of sodium salt in the potassium carbonate (textbook footnote), not from potassium itself being yellow.
钴玻璃只压黄光，不改变钾的谱线位置（404.4 nm 不变）——它解决「看得见」: Cobalt glass only suppresses yellow light and doesn't move potassium's line (404.4 nm stays): it makes it "visible", not "measured accurately".
去掉这一步：学生把钾背成「黄色（要滤）」或「紫色（不用管）」，一考就反。: Skip this step and students memorize potassium as "yellow (filter it)" or "purple (no need)", and get it backwards on the exam.
高频：观察钾的焰色为什么必须透过蓝色钴玻璃；钴玻璃的作用是什么。: Frequently tested: why potassium's flame must be viewed through blue cobalt glass; what cobalt glass does.
钾的紫色要透过蓝色钴玻璃才看得清——钴玻璃滤去黄光，把 589 nm 的干扰压到: Potassium's purple is only clear through blue cobalt glass: the glass filters out yellow, pushing the 589 nm interference down to 1/18 of the violet line (textbook footnote wording).
A2.2、A7.1、B2.6、标准值表 5–6、D2: A2.2, A7.1, B2.6, standard values tables 5–6, D2
三种金属放出的光不一样，是因为「能量不一样」吗？: The three metals give different light. Is that because of "different energy"?
从锂拨到钠、再到钾（本步一直戴着钴玻璃，免被钾的黄色干扰），看能级图上的箭头与: Switch from lithium to sodium to potassium (cobalt glass stays on in this step so potassium's yellow doesn't interfere) and watch the arrow and E on the energy level diagram
锂 670.8 nm / 1.85 eV（2p 与 2s 差 1.848 eV）: Lithium 670.8 nm / 1.85 eV (2p–2s gap 1.848 eV) → sodium 589.0 nm / 2.10 eV (3p–3s gap 2.104 eV) → potassium 404.4 nm / 3.07 eV (5p–4s gap 3.065 eV); all three satisfy E×λ = 1239.8 eV·nm. Potassium also has the 4p → 4s transition at 1.617 eV, i.e. 766.5 nm, in the near-infrared and barely visible to the eye
Li / Na / K 三个原子的能级（NIST 转引）: Energy levels of Li / Na / K atoms (cited from NIST)
颜色不同，本质是放出的光子能量不同。: Different colors fundamentally mean different photon energies.
能量越大 → 波长越短（偏紫）；能量越小 → 波长越长（偏红）。: Higher energy → shorter wavelength (toward violet); lower energy → longer wavelength (toward red).
钾最强的两条线在 766.5 / 769.9 nm（近红外）看不见，你看到的紫色: Potassium's two strongest lines are at 766.5 / 769.9 nm (near-infrared) and invisible; the purple you see comes from the weak 404.4 nm line. "Strongest" and "most visible" aren't the same.
去掉这一步：学生只会背「钾紫钠黄」，答不出为什么不同。: Skip this step and students only memorize "potassium purple, sodium yellow" and can't say why they differ.
高频：钾与钠焰色不同的原因（能级结构与跃迁能量不同）；E = hc/λ 的方向。: Frequently tested: why potassium and sodium flame colors differ (different energy level structures and transition energies); the direction of E = hc/λ.
每条谱线对应一对能级之差，E = hc/λ；不同元素的原子能级结构不同，跃迁放出: Each spectral line corresponds to the gap between a pair of energy levels, E = hc/λ; different elements have different atomic energy levels, so their transitions emit light of different energy and their flame colors differ (this is the answer to textbook exercise 12).
A2.5、A2.8、A5.1、B2.1 能级差表、D5、D6、D8: A2.5, A2.8, A5.1, B2.1 energy-gap table, D5, D6, D8
同一个元素，发出来的光和吸掉的光，位置为什么一样？: For the same element, why are the light it emits and the light it absorbs at the same positions?
把光谱仪切到吸收模式，比对两条线出现的位置: Switch the spectrometer to absorption mode and compare where the two lines appear
钠试样：发射模式在 589.0 与 589.6 有两条亮线；切到吸收模式后，同样: Sodium sample: emission mode shows two bright lines at 589.0 and 589.6; in absorption mode the same two positions become dark lines, within 1 nm
吸收线 ↔ 发射线：同一对能级: Absorption line ↔ emission line: the same pair of levels
钠试样 · 发射 → 吸收 · 狭缝 0.05 mm: Sodium sample · emission → absorption · slit 0.05 mm
吸收光谱和发射光谱不是两种元素，是同一个元素的两张照片。: Absorption and emission spectra aren't two elements; they're two pictures of the same element.
位置一样，是因为能级差一样：上去要吸这么多，下来就放这么多。: The positions match because the energy gap is the same: going up absorbs exactly as much as coming down releases.
光谱分析比焰色准：焰色会被微量钠盐骗，谱线不会。: Spectral analysis is more accurate than flame color: flame color can be fooled by traces of sodium salts, spectral lines can't.
去掉这一步：学生把吸收光谱当成另一套知识背，不知道两者是一回事。: Skip this step and students learn absorption spectra as a separate topic, not seeing they're the same thing.
高频：吸收光谱与发射光谱的关系；光谱分析为什么能鉴定元素。: Frequently tested: the relationship between absorption and emission spectra; why spectral analysis can identify elements.
同一对能级：电子上去要吸这么多能量、下来就放这么多，所以吸收线与发射线位置相同；: Same pair of levels: an electron absorbs exactly as much energy going up as it releases coming down, so absorption and emission lines are at the same positions; characteristic lines identify elements (caesium in 1860, rubidium in 1861 and helium in 1868 were all discovered this way).
把六种金属挨个烧一遍，颜色与谱线能对上一张表吗？: Burn the six metals one by one. Do the colors and lines match a single table?
把试样从锂一路拨到铜，一边报颜色一边看主谱线: Switch the sample from lithium all the way to copper, naming the color and checking the main line as you go
六种挨个走一遍：锂紫红 670.8 → 钠黄 589.0 → 钾紫 404.4（: One by one: lithium crimson 670.8 → sodium yellow 589.0 → potassium purple 404.4 (needs cobalt glass) → calcium brick red 622 → strontium magenta 682 → copper green 498 nm (calcium, strontium and copper give band spectra; the reading is the band center). The textbook table also lists rubidium (purple) and barium (yellow-green), rare in school labs and shown only for comparison
Li / Na / K / Ca / Sr / Cu 的焰色与主谱线: Flame colors and main lines of Li / Na / K / Ca / Sr / Cu
六种试样 · 狭缝 0.05 mm · 教材图2-9: Six samples · slit 0.05 mm · textbook Fig. 2-9
紫红 / 黄 / 紫 / 砖红 / 洋红 / 绿: Crimson / yellow / purple / brick red / magenta / green
六种颜色与教材表一一对应：先说颜色名，再说波长。: The six colors match the textbook table one to one: name the color first, then the wavelength.
绿、砖红、洋红是带状光谱（分子带）贡献的：读数写「带状光谱的中心（示意）」，不叫: Green, brick red and magenta come from band spectra (molecular bands): the reading says "band center (illustrative)", not a spectral line.
焰色回答「哪种元素」，光谱回答「哪条谱线、多少能量」。: Flame color answers "which element"; the spectrum answers "which line, how much energy".
去掉这一步：学生只记住钠钾两个，考到钙锶铜就空白。: Skip this step and students only remember sodium and potassium and draw a blank on calcium, strontium and copper.
常考：焰色试验的颜色对照表；锂紫红、钙砖红、锶洋红、铜绿各是什么元素。: Commonly tested: the flame test color table; which elements give crimson (Li), brick red (Ca), magenta (Sr) and green (Cu).
焰色是判断金属元素最快的定性办法（不需要仪器）；光谱仪给出精确的谱线与能量。两者: Flame color is the fastest qualitative way to identify a metal (no instrument needed); a spectrometer gives precise lines and energies. They are two levels of precision of the same principle (electron transitions).
考核：按教材的做法验出一支含钾试样: Assessment: detect a potassium-containing sample using the textbook method
钾盐 + 洗净的铂丝 + 蓝色钴玻璃 + 发射光谱，看到紫色、读出 404.4: Potassium salt + clean platinum wire + blue cobalt glass + emission spectrum: see purple, read 404.4 nm, and hold for 15 seconds; there will be two faults partway through
达标横幅「焰色试验 · 验出钾达标」；进入 5 s 后钴玻璃被取走（火焰转黄，钠: Pass banner "Flame test · potassium detected"; at 5 s the cobalt glass is taken away (flame turns yellow, sodium interference 2.14), and at 10 s the wire gets contaminated (still yellow even with cobalt glass, 1.91). Put each one right again
碳酸钾试样 · 铂丝洗净 · 钴玻璃开 · 发射光谱: Potassium carbonate sample · wire cleaned · cobalt glass on · emission spectrum
钴玻璃管「看得见」：把 589 nm 的钠干扰压下去。: Cobalt glass handles "visible": it suppresses the 589 nm sodium interference.
洗净管「测得准」：残留钠盐连钴玻璃都压不住（1.91）。: Cleaning handles "accurate": leftover sodium salt is too much even for cobalt glass (1.91).
发射模式才是看焰色，吸收模式是另一件事。: Emission mode is for viewing flame color; absorption mode is a different thing.

满分结构：先洗净铂丝 → 再蘸试样 → 透过蓝色钴玻璃看 → 读出 404.4: Full-marks structure: clean the wire first → dip in the sample → view through blue cobalt glass → read 404.4 nm. Write all four steps.

本班目标：验出钾，读到 404.4 nm: Class goal: detect potassium, read 404.4 nm
本班目标：按教材的做法验出一支含钾试样——先洗净铂丝，再蘸碳酸钾溶液，透过蓝色钴: Class goal: detect a potassium-containing sample using the textbook method: clean the wire, dip it in potassium carbonate solution, view through blue cobalt glass, read 404.4 nm, and hold for 15 seconds (textbook Exp. 2-6)
观察钾的焰色时必须透过蓝色钴玻璃，目的是: When observing potassium's flame color you must look through blue cobalt glass in order to
滤去黄光，避免碳酸钾里微量钠盐的干扰: Filter out yellow light and avoid interference from traces of sodium salt in the potassium carbonate
滤掉钾发出的紫光，只看钠的黄色: Filter out potassium's violet light and see only sodium's yellow
教材原话（必修1 p.40 脚注）：为了滤去黄色的光，避免碳酸钾中所含的微量钠盐: Textbook wording (Required Book 1, p.40 footnote): to filter out yellow light and avoid interference from traces of sodium salt in potassium carbonate. This lesson computed: cobalt glass pushes the 589 nm interference down to 1/18 of the violet line.
焰色试验前，铂丝要用盐酸洗净并灼烧至与原来火焰颜色相同，原因是: Before a flame test, the platinum wire is washed with hydrochloric acid and heated until the flame matches its original color because
让铂丝更容易蘸上溶液: It helps the wire pick up solution
除去铂丝上残留的钠盐等杂质，避免颜色串味: It removes leftover sodium salts and other impurities so colors don't carry over
盐酸能把金属离子还原成金属: Hydrochloric acid reduces metal ions to metal
不洗就把上一种试样的残留带过来。本课算过：铜试样在铂丝未洗净时火焰变黄（钠干扰可: Without cleaning, residue from the previous sample carries over. This lesson computed: the copper sample turns the flame yellow with an unclean wire (sodium interference visibility 3.53) and returns to green once cleaned (0.009).
光谱仪分不开钠的 589.0 nm 与 589.6 nm 时，主读数应当是: When the spectrometer can't separate sodium's 589.0 nm and 589.6 nm lines, the main reading should be
589.2 nm（两条线的中点）: 589.2 nm (the midpoint of the two lines)
When the instrument can't separate them, it reads the combined shape of the two lines, so you can only report the intensity-weighted midpoint: weighted 1.0 : 0.5, that's 589.2 nm. This is the instrument's precision; writing 589.0 is false precision.
钾与钠的焰色不同，根本原因是: The fundamental reason potassium and sodium have different flame colors is
钾的金属性比钠强: Potassium is more metallic than sodium
两种原子的能级结构不同，电子跃迁放出的光子能量不同: The two atoms have different energy level structures, so electron transitions emit photons of different energy
钾的焰色里混进了钠的黄光: Sodium's yellow light is mixed into potassium's flame color
教材练习 12 要求的答案：光的能量 = 两能级之差，E = hc/λ。钠 58: The answer textbook exercise 12 wants: light energy = the gap between two levels, E = hc/λ. Sodium's 589.0 nm is 2.10 eV, potassium's 404.4 nm is 3.07 eV. Option D describes interference, not "why the flame colors differ".
同一元素的发射光谱与吸收光谱，谱线的位置关系是: For the same element, the lines of the emission and absorption spectra are positioned
完全重合，位置相同: Exactly overlapping, at the same positions
吸收线比发射线整体偏红: With absorption lines shifted toward red overall
吸收线比发射线整体偏紫: With absorption lines shifted toward violet overall
同一对能级：电子上去要吸这么多能量，下来就放这么多，所以位置相同。本课把光谱仪从: The same pair of levels: an electron absorbs exactly as much going up as it releases coming down, so the positions match. In this lesson, switching the spectrometer from emission to absorption leaves sodium's two lines at 589.0 and 589.6, within 1 nm.
关于焰色试验，下列说法正确的是: Which statement about flame tests is correct?
焰色试验能测出试样中金属元素的含量: A flame test can measure how much of a metal element a sample contains
焰色试验是定性分析，只能判断试样所含的金属元素: A flame test is qualitative analysis and can only tell which metal elements a sample contains
焰色试验必须在暗室里进行才有现象: A flame test only works in a darkroom
只要颜色一样，就是同一种元素的同一种化合物: If the colors match, it must be the same compound of the same element
教材原话（必修1 p.41）：根据火焰呈现的特征颜色，可以判断试样所含的金属元素: Textbook wording (Required Book 1, p.41): from the characteristic color of the flame you can tell which metal element a sample contains; chemists call this qualitative analysis a flame test. It doesn't give amounts, and the textbook doesn't say it must be done in a darkroom.
钴玻璃已挡上：589 nm 的黄被压到紫线的 1/18，钾的紫色显出来: Cobalt glass in place: the 589 nm yellow is pushed down to 1/18 of the violet line and potassium's purple shows
去掉钴玻璃：碳酸钾里的微量钠盐把火焰染黄，紫色看不见了: Cobalt glass removed: traces of sodium salt in the potassium carbonate turn the flame yellow, and the purple disappears
铂丝已用盐酸洗净并灼烧到火焰空白：火焰回到试样本身的颜色: Wire washed with HCl and heated until the flame is blank: the flame returns to the sample's own color
铂丝未洗净：上一个试样残留的钠盐还在，火焰被染黄: Wire not cleaned: sodium salt left from the previous sample is still there and turns the flame yellow
光谱仪切到吸收光谱：亮线变成同位置的暗线: Spectrometer switched to absorption: bright lines become dark lines at the same positions
光谱仪切回发射光谱：试样发出的光在特征波长上出现亮线: Spectrometer switched back to emission: the sample's light shows bright lines at its characteristic wavelengths
异常 1：钴玻璃被取走——火焰转黄，先把钴玻璃挡回去: Fault 1: the cobalt glass was taken away. The flame turns yellow, so put the cobalt glass back first
异常 2：铂丝被上一个试样污染——即使戴钴玻璃仍是黄，先洗净再灼烧: Fault 2: the wire was contaminated by the previous sample. It's yellow even with cobalt glass, so clean and heat it first
